verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's docs describe a hosted MCP server that lets AI assistants query events, funnels, retention, etc. via natural language and explicitly includes a 'Create-Dashboard' tool to build dashboards with cards and reports, directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that an agent can complete a full end-to-end dashboard build via MCP or API, and no OpenAPI spec is discoverable (probe shows 404s) to confirm parallel API-driven dashboard creation.
